payload.text: Annik Engineering Skip to content Increasing your production plant profitability by optimizing your powder and bulk solid material handling. We Solve Common Problems How many safety incidents did your company have last year? How much turnover and employee burnout are you dealing with due to excessive manual labor processes? How much time, materials, and product are lost because of inefficient handling processes? What would it mean to your company if you could process an extra batch during every shift? We can help get your solids handling dialed in! Companies we have worked with have seen their safety incidents go down and their staff morale go up. The solution often results in labor savings because of the automation that is introduced. Output rates increase, often dramatically. If material is being mixed, weighed, and batched there is less lost material because the manually handling of material is minimal. The quality of the end product is improved and profitability increases. What We Do For Our Customers Increase production capacity & efficiency by improving equipment reliability Reduce labor costs & operator injury by automating manual processes Improve finished product quality with high performance inspection & processing equipment Facilitate product line expansion by implementing staged-growth strategies Modernize housekeeping & safety practices to comply with current industry standards We strive for excellence in every interaction and work very hard to make it easy for our customers to do business with us time after time. Let’s discuss the challenges you face in your operation to see how we can help you find solutions!
